entities.name: Mending of the Clan Tree
entities.description: Event on Cridhe ending centuries of division after the Parting by reviving the Clan Tree.

entities.name: Clan Tree
entities.description: Sacred tree destroyed in the Parting and reborn as a sapling.

entities.name: Nazir
entities.description: Felonarch of Inys Nohr, healed by Aylith.

entities.name: Arn
entities.description: Former slave turned rebel who united the Far Clans.

entities.name: Feryar
entities.description: Elven scholar who rescued Arn and offered mirkalbion sanctuary.

entities.name: Mirkalbion
entities.description: Twisted beings reliant on eternal darkness.

entities.name: Malvos
entities.description: Sangrazul who manipulated events, left to die by a shroud.

events.summary: Aylith, recovering from Nazir's wound, goes to Inys Haen as war looms.
events.quote: Aylith made her way to Inys Haen

events.summary: Arn, betrayed and left to die, is rescued by Feryar and brings the Far Clans into battle at the spring equinox.
events.quote: he returned just in time to bring the clans into the battle

events.summary: Aylith ambushes Nazir but spares him, entering his soul and healing him of madness and mutations.
events.quote: healing him of the madness, pain, and mutations

events.summary: Aylith and Nazir perform the Awakening Ritual, the ice melts and a Clan Tree sapling sprouts.
events.quote: a small sapling pushed through the soil

events.summary: Seeing the reborn Clan Tree, the armies halt and lay down arms.
events.quote: the armies laid down their weapons

events.summary: Feryar offers the mirkalbion sanctuary in Loch Prith.
events.quote: Feryar offered them sanctuary in Loch Prith

events.summary: Tempé visits Malvos, who cannot give the knowledge she seeks, and leaves him to be devoured by a shroud.
events.quote: she left him to his fate

relations.quote: Rescued by the elven scholar Feryar
a wound given to her by the Felonarch
